title: Act 3 - Chapter 2: Brine Road, Deep Sea & Boon Island (Chuck & Storm Badge)
synopsis: Journey west across the ocean swells of Brine Road West. Claim the Scuba Gear from the offshore diver to unlock the Dive ability, plunge into the deep oceanic abyss of the Deep Sea trench, investigate the rusted decks of the Old Shipwreck to confront a static Dhelmise, and land on Boon Island. Trade Heart Scales at the Joyful Game Corner, then trek north to the roaring waterfall to challenge Cianwood's Gym Leader Chuck in a 5 vs 5 duel for the Storm Badge and Navel Ticket.
